_meta.purpose: Source data for assets/figures/ad-cost.svg. Advertising spend only -- not incentives, not the survey platform, not our fee. Computed read-only against Virtual Lab production CockroachDB cluster vprod.
read_before_use: This is NOT a price and must never be rendered as one. Advertising spend only.
The unit is the STUDY, not the country. Country averages hide the spread that matters: Nigeria alone runs $0.04 to $8.89 across 20 studies while its country average is $4.74.
Denominator is respondents the study NEWLY RECRUITED -- first appearance in any study. An endline re-contacts a panel it did not pay to recruit.
Spend is the MAX reported cumulative spend per campaign/stratum/day, never the sum -- temp=true rows are cumulative intra-day snapshots.

population.description: Advertising cost per respondent newly recruited, one value per study.
population.newly_recruited: A respondent whose first appearance in any study is in this one.
filters: at least 80% of the study's first-appearance respondents are uniquely its own -- excludes umbrella study groups whose rows share one respondent set
campaigns appearing under more than one study_id are dropped (7 of 157)

spread_within_one_country.note: Nigeria, 20 studies. This is why the country average was the wrong unit.

context_not_published.note: Country-level figures, computed first and rejected as the unit. Kept so the reasoning can be re-checked. DO NOT RENDER.

query: WITH x AS (SELECT c.key AS camp, s.key AS strat, coalesce(s.value->>'date_start', e.period_start::date::string) AS d, max((s.value->>'spend')::float8) AS spend FROM recruitment_data_events e, jsonb_each(e.data) AS c, jsonb_each(c.value) AS s WHERE jsonb_typeof(c.value)='object' AND s.value->>'spend' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3), cs AS (SELECT c.key AS camp, min(e.study_id::string) AS sid FROM recruitment_data_events e, jsonb_each(e.data) AS c WHERE jsonb_typeof(c.value)='object' GROUP BY c.key HAVING count(DISTINCT e.study_id)=1), sp AS (SELECT cs.sid, sum(x.spend) AS spend FROM x JOIN cs ON cs.camp=x.camp GROUP BY 1), fs AS (SELECT study_id, user_id, min(timestamp) AS ts FROM inference_data GROUP BY 1,2), t0 AS (SELECT user_id, min(ts) AS t FROM fs GROUP BY 1), firsts AS (SELECT f.user_id, f.study_id FROM fs f JOIN t0 ON t0.user_id=f.user_id AND f.ts=t0.t), k AS (SELECT user_id, count(DISTINCT study_id) AS n FROM firsts GROUP BY 1), per AS (SELECT f.study_id::string AS sid, count(*)::float8 AS all_first, count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.n=1)::float8 AS newresp FROM firsts f JOIN k ON k.user_id=f.user_id GROUP BY 1), t AS (SELECT sp.sid, sp.spend, per.newresp, sp.spend/per.newresp AS cost FROM sp JOIN per ON per.sid=sp.sid WHERE per.newresp >= 200 AND per.newresp/per.all_first >= 0.8) SELECT count(*), percentile_cont(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cost), percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cost), percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cost), percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cost), percentile_cont(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cost), min(cost), max(cost), sum(spend), sum(newresp) FROM t;
